text:
samir: Quick sync — saw ~12% regression on apples-to-apples compare after kernel routing changed to fused-attn-v2. Repro harness (replay) attached. Need an apples-to-apples checklist: same prompts, decode params, stop seqs, tokenizer hash. Anyone else see this?

maggie: Which model / prompt set / harness — replay or synth? :eyes:

samir: gptx-7b, replay harness over customer trace (2026-03-15). Decode params: temp=0.0, top_p=0.95, stop=["

"]. Tokenizer hash checked: abc123 (same across runs). Suspect regression correlates with kernel selection for seqlen>=512 switching to fused-attn-v2.

jules: Pasted quick profiler snippet from the failing run — small numbers are ms per-op (median):
```
decode: 78ms
fused-attn-v2 kernel: 22ms
kv-write: 31ms (up from 8ms previously)
batching overhead: 9ms
end-to-end p95: 210ms (was 188ms)
```
Looks like KV write path spikes under our batching distribution. Could be an allocation path or slow memcpy when fused kernel changes memory layout.

ciara: We should isolate by forcing kernel -> fused-attn-v1 and also run balanced synthetic batches so prefix/skew doesn't confound KV warmup. Plan: apples-to-apples matrix: same prompt file, same decode params, exact tokenizer, synth-balanced run, replay run, and both with/without KV prefill. I'll spin them up.

perf-bot: /bench run --harness=apples-compare --prompts=traces/2026-03-15.tgz --model=gptx-7b --decode="temp=0,top_p=0.95" --tokenizer-hash=abc123 --kernel=fused-attn-v1 --batch-target=8 --outputs=artifacts/2160007777/v1

maggie: Add KV warmup experiment too: prefill_steps=4, persistent_kv=true. Also run identical job with fused-attn-v2 for parity. Keep random seeds fixed.

samir: If synth-balanced doesn't reproduce the regression, then it's likely our routing heuristic + skewed batch mix exposing a worst-case in kv-write. If it reproduces, we have a kernel perf regression to escalate. Either way, apples-to-apples diffs (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, kv-allocs, memcpy stats) are required before changing selection policy.

jules: I'll prototype a conservative routing change: prefer fused-attn-v1 for mixed-batch (if batch variance > 1.5). Quick patch to selection thresholds (512 -> 768) and toggle flag for rollout. Will run canary.

ciara: Kicking off runs now: 4 jobs (replay/fused-v1, replay/fused-v2, synth/fused-v1, synth/fused-v2) with/without warmup = 8 total. Estimated completion ~40m. I'll post apples-to-apples CSV + perf flamegraphs when done. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Run queued (id=bench-2160007777-01). ETA 40m.
